title: ChatGPT bet C$3,000 on a −3600 favourite. It won 34-16. #AI #ChatGPT #NCAAF
description:
3 AIs (Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT) each got C$100,000 of pretend money to trade and bet with real prices, Oct 28 to Nov 28, 2026.
ChatGPT bet C$3,000 on the Mississippi State Bulldogs moneyline at −3600 (Tennessee Tech Golden Eagles @ Mississippi State Bulldogs). Its reason, from the public ledger: "High-risk sports has already met its total requirement, so I am using only the daily floor stake on the same heavy favorite rather than adding unnecessary variance."
Final: Tennessee Tech Golden Eagles 16, Mississippi State Bulldogs 34. ChatGPT won C$83.
Check it yourself: transaction IDs X-AIS-045 and X-AIS-046 at PaperTrades.AI
Pretend money. Not betting or investment advice.
